data.long_meaning: The name Murih is derived from the Arabic word 'muraha' which means to desire or yearn. It is a spiritual name that symbolizes a deep longing for the pleasure of Allah. The name Murih carries the meaning “Desiring, Longing, Yearning” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Murih usually hope their child will grow to embody desiring, longing, yearning and live with faith, good character and purpose.
